purpose: Count-matched value-label-selection screen; prepare first, collect and train only in separate explicit stages.

collection.players: Exact checkpoint4 on both sides, fixed throughout collection; root noise on, temperature1 for first12 continuation turns and0 afterwards.
collection.roots: One turn-boundary root per inherited family, selected before outcomes from existing train/development panels. No arena roots or trajectories. Preserve old split and exclude canonical/mirrored crossovers.
collection.cutoffs: Keep raw unfinished games without WDL labels. Every scheduled game must have a report before assembly. Missing/watchdog games invalidate this cohort until explicitly resolved, never treated as draws or silently retried.
collection.bounds: No automatic cohort extension or additional cloud allocation. A timeout retains reports and permits only known unstarted tasks to continue after review. No collection or inference concurrently with the existing equal-time arena on this host.

panels.sampling: Deterministic family round-robin; canonical deduplication. Fresh rows need verified terminal same-model provenance; max64 rows/family. Legacy max128 rows/family. Do not rebalance by win/draw/loss. Old outcomes remain unchanged.

arms.mixed: Control: randomly choose terminal-labeled rows within each exact batch, matching selfplay arm's value-label count; independent frozen control-mask RNG.
arms.selfplay: Value loss uses explicit same-checkpoint selfplay outcomes only; all rows still contribute identical policy targets.

training.controls: Restore exact checkpoint4 model AND Adam independently for every seed/arm; same policy row order, batch boundaries, learning rate, update count, and actual value-labeled exposure count in each batch. Freeze inputs/order/masks before inference. Incomplete arms invalidate comparison; retain every arm and no best-seed selection.

decision.status: Exploratory development screen, not automatic selection or promotion
decision.primary: Fresh same-baseline selfplay holdout WDL logloss; report Brier and calibration diagnostics when available. Report paired selfplay-minus-mixed deltas for all3 seeds.
advance_to_tactics_if: All integrity/data readiness/exposure checks pass and all six arms complete.
Mean paired primary WDL logloss delta <= -0.01, at least2/3 seeds improve, and fixed representative seed20261125 has nonpositive paired delta.
Mean nonforced policy NLL on the unchanged legacy panel worsens by <=0.02 versus baseline for both teacher and pooled neural sources; fixed representative also respects this tolerance.
decision.diagnostics: Teacher/mixed WDL remains reported but is not a veto for a deliberately changed value objective. Show terminal/unfinished rates, W/D/L and game/family counts, per-batch value exposures, source mix, and A/B label overlap.
decision.next: If development checks pass, run baseline and both fixed-seed arms on development tactics; require legal complete plans, immediate-HQ anchors, and no loss of baseline development pass count. Then freeze new paired openings and bounded equal-time matches versus each other, baseline and CPU. Never use those arena trajectories as training data. A larger independent evaluation is required before deployment.
decision.if_inconclusive: Do not choose a favorable seed, relax thresholds, extend training, or claim mixed outcomes are wrong. Review data/uncertainty and plan a separate experiment.
decision.limitations: This tests a practical label-selection change, which also changes the distribution of positions receiving value supervision. It does not isolate opponent provenance causally. A stronger later control can compare original and fresh selfplay outcomes at identical roots. Development families are reused; three shuffle seeds are not independent game-level evidence.
